subject: Re: US-West latency spike during peak window 1/JAN - remediation & account remedy
messages:
From: Ben Thomas <ben.thomas@acme-corp.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Acme Platform Team <platform-team@acme-corp.com>, Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intermittent latency spike across US-West pool (samples attached)

Sooj-in,

This morning between ~08:23 and 08:45 PST we saw a sharp P95 jump (baseline ~220ms -> ~1.8s) and a cluster of timed-out requests that impacted user flows. We're sampling traces and request ids in the attached CSV. Can you confirm whether this corresponds to any maintenance/rollout or isolated capacity event on your side?

We need an incident timeline and a proposal for remediation/compensation if this qualifies under your SLOs. We're on an aggressive pilot schedule and this hit a go-live test.

-Ben
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corp

Attachment: acme_sample_traces_01010.csv (text/csv)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Thomas <ben.thomas@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Acme Platform Team <platform-team@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent latency spike across US-West pool (samples attached)

Hi Ben — thanks for the traces. We're investigating now. Ops alerted to pod restarts in the US-West dedicated pool around 08:30 and noted a driver orchestration rollout that overlapped with your peak concurrency. We're collecting the full timeline and will confirm root cause.

As an interim customer remedy I propose: 1) a $2,500 platform credit applied to your account, and 2) a 30-day extension of your pilot period. I'd like internal approval before issuing the credit note.

Sooj-in Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent latency spike across US-West pool (samples attached)

Sooj-in,

Thanks for the quick response. A couple of asks before we commit:
- Provide a short, defensible calculation for the credit (minutes affected, % of requests, or sampled failures).
- Confirm whether the rollout was scheduled and whether there was any canary/fallback.

I support a goodwill remediation, start with $2.5k and escalate to Markus/finance if the math justifies more. Keep the note tight for approval.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Success

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: approve $2,500 credit + 30-day extension for Acme (incident 2026-01-10)

Markus,

Quick ask for sign-off. Summary from sampled traces (attached acme_sample_traces_01010.csv):
- Window: 2026-01-10 08:23-08:45 PST (~22 minutes)
- Observed P95: baseline ~220ms -> peak ~1.8s
- Sampled request failures/timeouts: ~340 requests

Proposed remedy: $2,500 platform credit + 30-day pilot extension. Ops will deliver an RCA within 48 hours. Please advise if finance should issue the credit note under ACME-ENT-2025 and apply on the next invoice cycle.

Thanks,
Sooj-in

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: approve $2,500 credit + 30-day extension for Acme (incident 2026-01-10)

Approved. Authorize the $2,500 credit and the 30-day pilot extension. Instruct Finance to generate a credit note referencing incident 2026-01-10 and deal ACME-ENT-2025, to be applied in the next billing cycle. I'll also coordinate with Ops to prevent overlapping rollouts during peak windows in US-West.

-Markus Klein
VP, Revenue Operations

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Thomas <ben.thomas@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@acme-corp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: US-West latency spike during peak window — remediation & account remedy

Hi Ben,

Thanks for your patience. Short summary and actions taken:
- Cause: a driver/orchestration rollout coincided with pod churn in the US-West Dedicated pool during your peak concurrency (08:23-08:45 PST). Ops reverted the rollout, added a throttling guard, and will run an extended canary for 72 hours. RCA forthcoming.

Remedy issued today:
- $2,500 platform credit (reference: ACME-ENT-2025, incident 2026-01-10)
- 30-day pilot extension (no change to pricing)

Attached: redwood_credit_note_20260115.pdf and an extract of reviewed traces. Please confirm receipt and whether you want the credit applied to a specific invoice. RCA will follow within 48 hours.

Sooj-in Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Thomas <ben.thomas@acme-corp.com>
